notes: Feed URLs were verified by direct HTTP fetch (curl with a browser User-Agent), not guessed. Taylor & Francis, Cambridge Core, and some other publisher platforms return HTTP 403 to naive/default HTTP clients and to automated browser-fetch tools that don't send a realistic User-Agent + headers -- when polling these feeds in production, set a normal desktop browser User-Agent string.
